dialect_varying_payloads.reason: The same declaration llm_tool_llm carries, narrowed to the records this rendering takes from the other instrumentor. OpenInference records an LLM span's whole request envelope in input.value and the whole provider response in output.value; OTel GenAI records the normalized conversation in gen_ai.input.messages / gen_ai.output.messages. One strictly contains the other plus more, so neither is a re-encoding of the other and SPEC.md 3.3 constrains neither (FIXTURES.md 4.4). s1 and s3 are the two records the otel_genai adapter reads here, so those four payloads are the whole of the difference between this rendering and llm_tool_llm's openinference one -- s0.inputs is NOT declared, because s0 is read by the openinference adapter in this rendering and its mime and value agree with expected/graph.json exactly. The tool payloads on s2 are declared nowhere and stay fully compared.
